title: Five Discourses on Not Detecting Form, Etc.
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 33.31–35 Linked Discourses 33.31–35
  • 1. Vacchagottavagga 1. With Vacchagotta

Rūpaanupalakkhaṇādisuttapañcaka Five Discourses on Not Detecting Form, Etc.

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpe kho, vaccha, anupalakkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, anupalakkhaṇā …pe…. “Vaccha, it is because of not detecting form …”

Pañcatiṁsatimaṁ.
